basic_info.description: You CAN afford to live in Bernal! Just a few blocks from the heart of coveted Cortland promenade, this modernized 2BR/1BA condo is a true rarity. Located in a charming turn-of-the-century corner duplex that is detached on 3-sides, there is an abundance of natural light throughout the unit. A remodeled chef's kitchen overlooks a lovely garden and incl Caesarstone countertops, a com'l Viking range, & s/s appliances. Tall ceilings and hardwood floors frame period details and millwork. There is plenty of closet space, plus add'l deeded storage and laundry rooms below. An exclusive use patio offers a serene space to relax and entertain outdoors. Convenient public trans options nearby. Food-lovers will relish nearby Alemany Farmers Market!
